days.studyBrief: Complete algebra/function gaps; prioritise discriminants, factor/remainder theorem, simultaneous equations and inequalities.
days.notes: Accuracy first; look for structural shortcuts.

days.studyBrief: Sequences/series, recurrences, lines, circles and intersections.
days.notes: Write one-line recognition notes after each miss.

days.studyBrief: Exact values, radians, trig graphs/equations, sine/cosine rules and 2D/3D reasoning.
days.notes: No calculator; sketch before solving.

days.studyBrief: Log laws/equations, exponential structure, graph transformations and composition.
days.notes: Practise interpreting equations graphically.

days.studyBrief: Gradients, tangents/normals, stationary points and monotonicity.
days.notes: Emphasise why differentiation is useful.

days.studyBrief: Definite/indefinite integration, areas, FTC ideas, trapezium reasoning and simple DEs.
days.notes: Separate signed integral from geometric area.

days.studyBrief: Full official TMUA 2017 Paper 1 (75 min) + complete review.
days.notes: Classify every error: knowledge / approach / algebra / misread / slow / careless.

days.studyBrief: Exact arithmetic, factors/primes, standard form, bounds/estimation and number structure.
days.notes: Use contest questions for fast non-routine fluency.

days.studyBrief: Ratios, percentages, scale factors, direct/inverse proportion, growth and rates.
days.notes: Prefer modelling and multi-step contexts over routine drills.

days.studyBrief: Angles, congruence/similarity, circle theorems, mensuration, bearings/3D and vectors.
days.notes: Draw large diagrams; label known facts.

days.studyBrief: Data summaries/representations, conditional probability, trees/Venn diagrams and counting.
days.notes: Check independence/dependence explicitly.

days.studyBrief: Implication, converse, contrapositive, counterexample and translating English statements.
days.notes: Aim for near-perfect accuracy on logical form.

days.studyBrief: Necessary/sufficient conditions, quantifier-style reasoning and negation.
days.notes: Say the direction of every implication aloud before solving.

days.studyBrief: Direct proof, cases, contradiction, counterexample and longer reasoning chains.
days.notes: Write complete solutions for the long problems.

days.studyBrief: Full official TMUA 2017 Paper 2 (75 min) + deep review.
days.notes: Focus on the shortest valid reasoning route.

days.studyBrief: Hard mixed algebra/functions/sequences/graphs.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: Recognise structure before calculation.

days.studyBrief: Hard geometry, coordinate geometry and trigonometry.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: Try geometric and algebraic routes; compare.

days.studyBrief: Non-routine differentiation/integration combined with graphs.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: Reduce routine manipulation; increase interpretation.

days.studyBrief: Counting, probability, divisibility and discrete problem solving.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: Use systematic cases; avoid unstructured enumeration.

days.studyBrief: Timed mixed Paper 2 set from mocks/practice.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: Track logic-language errors separately from mathematical errors.

days.studyBrief: Official TMUA 2018 Paper 1, 75 minutes.
days.notes: Target clean first-pass execution and sensible skips.

days.studyBrief: Official TMUA 2018 Paper 2, 75 minutes.
days.notes: Target no avoidable logic mistakes.

days.studyBrief: Use the allocated pool against your three largest recurring error categories.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: Start with 6 questions per weakness; use substitutes only if needed.

days.studyBrief: Official TMUA 2019 Papers 1 + 2 under realistic conditions.
days.dailyTarget: Work toward 34+/40; analyse every uncertain answer
days.notes: 150 minutes total plus a realistic short break; review later the same day or next morning.

days.studyBrief: A small set of MAT/CSAT/Maclaurin/BMO/SMC problems.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: Quality over quantity; do not turn this into specialist olympiad study.

days.studyBrief: Fresh mock/practice Paper 2 reasoning.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: Logic terminology should now cause essentially zero errors.

days.studyBrief: Four timed sets of five contest questions.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: If no progress after ~90 seconds, mark/skip/return.

days.studyBrief: Official TMUA 2020 Papers 1 + 2.
days.dailyTarget: Work toward 34+/40; analyse every uncertain answer
days.notes: Measure correct, guesses, abandoned questions, >6-min questions and missed shortcuts.

days.studyBrief: Redo red errors, then complete the fresh repair set.
days.dailyTarget: High-quality solution rate >80% on assigned work
days.notes: 70% red weaknesses, 25% amber, 5% green.

days.studyBrief: Official TMUA 2021 Papers 1 + 2, then consolidate the error log.
days.dailyTarget: Work toward 34+/40; analyse every uncertain answer
days.notes: Do not use 2022 official papers; keep them preserved.
